title: Two Yank Sing restaurants owed workers wages and $1 million in tips

beats.text: Workers at two Yank Sing restaurants challenged their pay.

visual.sub: Workers brought their pay records into a joint investigation

beats.text: Their complaints reached the Chinese Progressive Association in 2013.

visual.kicker: Workers brought their pay records into a joint investigation

beats.text: Investigators said employees received the state minimum of $8 an hour.

visual.label: The local minimum rose above the state rate

beats.text: San Francisco required $10.55 an hour in 2013.
That left a difference of $2.55 for each straight-time hour.

visual.kicker: The local minimum rose above the state rate

beats.text: The investigation traced roughly $1 million in tips over four years.

visual.label: Investigators traced the tips and wages separately

beats.text: Management kept tips or directed them to ineligible employees.

visual.kicker: Investigators traced the tips and wages separately

beats.text: The state announced a $4 million distribution for 280 workers.

visual.label: Investigators traced the tips and wages separately

beats.text: Minimum wage and overtime accounted for about $1.4 million each.
A later account put the agreement at $4.2 million.

visual.kicker: The later reports describe one settlement at different precision

beats.text: The two figures describe the same settlement.

visual.kicker: The later reports describe one settlement at different precision

beats.text: The workers also gained a compliance committee and paid holidays.
